tool.name: run_command
tool.description: Execute a shell command on the system

when_to_use.trigger: User asks to run a specific command
Need real-time system information not available via other tools
User asks to install, update, or remove packages
User asks to perform system maintenance tasks

parameters.param: Run with sudo privileges (requires additional confirmation)

safety_rules.rule: NEVER execute: rm -rf /, dd if=/dev/zero, mkfs on mounted volumes
NEVER execute commands that could wipe data without explicit confirmation
NEVER pipe curl/wget output directly to shell (curl | bash)
Always explain what the command will do before running
Suggest --dry-run or -n flags for destructive commands
Limit sudo usage to operations that truly require it
Prefer specific tools over general shell commands when available

tool.output_format: Returns: { "stdout": string, // Command output "stderr": string, // Error output "exit_code": integer, // 0 = success "duration_ms": integer, "command": string, // Executed command "truncated": boolean // True if output was truncated }
